free_only_eligibility_rule: The complete 2019-2024 history must be retrievable at zero monetary cost without a temporary trial, card, paid extension, access-control bypass, or current-supply look-ahead.
metric_definition: circulating market capitalization in USD at the observation time
identity_requirements: canonical identity with temporal aliases where known
stablecoin, wrapped and duplicate-network exclusions are explicit
availability_time_requirements: observation and provider publication times are UTC-aware
available_at is proven or conservatively bounded
no current supply is projected backward
no observation after the sealed cutoff
ranking_rule: positive finite circulating market_cap_usd descending, then canonical_asset_id ascending as deterministic tie-breaker
source_selection_gates: at least thirty eligible historical assets per snapshot unless source proves fewer existed
all twenty-four reference Top-6 observations covered
no estimated, FDV or total-supply fallback
raw evidence and deterministic offline parser preserved
sealed_data_boundary: No 2025 or 2026 data, current survivor lists, or latest endpoints may enter the research panel.
